'''Observation''' was the branch of [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]]. Despised by the military, [[CompForce Observer]]s were officially seconded to military units to learn how the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] war machine functioned. In reality, they were [[Spy/Legends|spies]] who were placed to ensure that officers and enlisted personnel were showing proper respect to the tenets of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. The fact that they were spies was an open secret, and officers and enlisted personnel alike hated having to pretend otherwise. Personnel knew not to insult Observers, as that ensured a quick end to their career.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
